description: Gray street cleaning sign on a pole, multi-story residential buildings with rounded bay windows, a heavily pruned bare tree, a utility pole with multiple wires, concrete sidewalk, small tree in a square brick planter, yellow residential building, street light pole.

Left building section with green door, long concrete stairs with blue metal handrails, central building entrance with double light blue/green doors and white fluted columns, multi-story light-colored building facade with upper left bay window, grey-blue decorative scrollwork bands, two stacked bay windows on the right, light yellow painted foundation, angled concrete retaining wall in the foreground, and numerous utility wires overhead.

Steep asphalt street with cracks, light yellow multi-story building with stucco facade, arched windows, small balconies, decorative accents, and two light-colored garage doors with arched window inserts, metal gate to the left of the yellow building's garage, light blue multi-story building with horizontal siding, large rectangular and smaller square windows, and a white balcony with a railing, light-colored multi-story building with stacked bay windows and ornate architectural details, wooden utility pole with transformer and numerous overhead power lines, another multi-story building with stacked bay windows and a pinkish/light orange facade, small trees or bushes in front of the bay window buildings.
